items.text: Kinyumba cha Wakohani Wabaa
Lawi orekoghe na wana wadadu: Gershomu, Kohathi, na Merari.
Wana wa Kohathi ni: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni, na Uzieli.
Wana wa Amramu ni: Haruni, Musa, na Miriamu. Wana wa Haruni ni: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari, na Ithamari.
Na kivalwa cha Eleazari cherenughaneghe huwu: Abishua,
Buki, Uzi,
Zerahia, Meraiothi,
Amaria, Ahitubu,
Zadoku, Ahimaazi,
Azaria, Johanani,
Azaria (nuo orekoghe ukibonya kazi ya wukohani andenyi ya Hekalu iyo ereaghiloghe ni Solomoni aho Jerusalemu).
Amaria, Ahitubu,
Zadoku, Shalumu,
Hilkia, Azaria,
Seraia Jehosadaki;
na Jehosadaki ukabarishwa, iji BWANA orewibarishireghe wandu wa Juda na Jerusalemu ukimtumia Nebukadnezari.
Kivalwa chimu cha Lawi
Lawi orekoghe na wana wadadu: Gershomu, Kohathi, na Merari.
Marina gha wana wa Gershomu ni agha: Libni na Shimei.
Wana wa Kohathi ni: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni, na Uzieli.
Wana wa Merari ni: Mahli na Mushi. Ivi nivo vinyumba va Walawi kunughana na kichuku chawo.
Kivalwa cha Gershomu cherenughaneghe huwu: Jahathi, Zima,
Joa, ido, Zera, na Jeatherai.
Kivalwa cha Kohathi cherenughaneghe huwu: Aminadabu, Kora, Asiri,
Elkana, Elisafu, Asiri,
Tahathi, Urieli; Uzia, na Shauli.
Elkana orekoghe na wana wawi: Amasai na Ahimothi.
Kivalwa cha Ahimothi cherenughaneghe huwu kivalwa kwa kivalwa: Elkana, Nahathi,
Eliabu, Jerohamu, na Elkana.
Samueli orekoghe na wana wawi: mwana wake wa imbiri Joeli na wa kawi ni Abija.
Ichi nicho kivalwa cha Merari kivalwa kwa kivalwa: Merari, Libni, Shimei, Uza,
Shimea, Hagai, na Asaia.
Kwaya ya Hekalunyi
Awa niwo wandu Mzuri Daudi orewiwikieghe wikaie vilongozi veboresha Hekalunyi kwa BWANA nyuma ya Sanduku ya Ilaghano kuredwa aho.
Werekoghe wikiboresha aho Hemenyi ekwania imbiri Solomoni useaghie Hekalu aho Jerusalemu. Wikakaia wikidumika kwa mpango.
Wandu awo na wana wawo niwo awa: Kivalwa cha Kohathi: Hemani mwana wa Joeli kilongozi wa kwaya ya imbiri, wawae Samueli.
Kivalwa chake chikakaia Elkana na Jerohamu, na Elieli, na Toa,
Sufu, Elkana, Mahathi, Amasai,
Elkana, Joeli, Azaria, Sefania,
Tohathi, Asiri, Ebiasafu, Kora,
Ishari, Kohathi, Lawi mwana wa Jakobo.
Mruna oremtesiagha kwaya ya kawi ni Asafu; nao orekoghe mwana wa Berekia, wawae Shimea.
Kivalwa chake chikakaia Ba-aseia, Mikaeli, na Malkija;
Ethini, Zera, Adaia,
Ethani, Zima, Shimei,
Johathi, Gershomu, na Lawi.
Werekwanyeghe na waruna, na wana wa Merari; nawo ni: Ethani mwana wa Kishi wawae Abdi, kivalwa cha Maluki,
na Hashabia, nawo ni Wen-Amazia; Hilkia,
Amzi, Bani, Shemeri,
Mahili, Mushi, Merari mwana wa Lawi,
na waruna wose Walawi werewikiloghe wibonye wudumiki ghose ghwa wutasi.
Kivalwa cha Haruni

Haruni na wana wake werekoghe wikifunya vizongona aighu ya madhabahu gha vizongona vekora na aighu ya madhabahu ghefukira marumba kwa wundu ghwa wudumiki ghose gwa Andu kwa Wueli Kuchumbie. Wikabonya wupatanisho kwa wundu ghwa Israeli karakara na malagho ghose gherelaghiriloghe ni Musa mdumiki wa Mlungu.
Kivalwa cha Haruni cherenughaneghe huwu: Eleazari, Finehasi, Abishua,
Buki, Uzi, Zerahia,
Meraiothi, Amaria, Ahitubu,
Zadoku, na Ahimaazi.
Andu Walawi werekoghe wikikaia
Iji nijo isanga jerenekeloghe kichuku cha Kohathi wa kivalwa cha Haruni. Werepatireghe ifungu ja imbiri ja isanga jerenekeloghe Walawi.
Werenekeloghe Hebroni andenyi ya isanga ja Juda na masanga ghelishira mbai na mbai yaro.
Ela mbuwa na mizi yaro erenekeloghe Kalebu mwana wa Jefune.

Mizi erenekeloghe wana wa Haruni ni Hebroni, ugho ghorekoghe muzi ghokimbiria; na Libna, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira, Jatiri na milamba yaro elishira, na Libna, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Jatiri na Eshtemoa, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;
Hileni, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Debiri, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;
Ashani, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; na Beth-Shemeshi chiamweri na milamba yaro elishira.
Na kufuma kwa mbari ya Benjamini, werenekeloghe Geba chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; na Anathothi chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira. Mizi yose na nyumba rawo erekoghe ikumi na idadu.
Awo Wakohathi wamu werenekeloghe mizi ikumi kufuma kwa nusu ya kichuku cha Manase chiko cha magharibi kwa kukaba kura.
Wagershoni werenekeloghe mizi ikumi na idadu kunughana na nyumba rawo kufuma kwa vichuku va Isakari, Asheri, Naftali na Manase viko Bashani.
Wamerari werenekeloghe mizi ikumi na iwi kunughana na nyumba rawo kufuma kwa vichuku va Reubeni na Gadi, na Zebluni.
Kwa huwo Waisraeli wikawineka Walawi mizi na milamba yaro elishira.
(Iyo mizi yaghorwa kwa marina kufuma kwa vichuku va Juda na Benjamini nayo wori erenekeloghe kwa kukaba kura.)
Nyumba rimu ra wana wa Kohathi rerepatireghe mizi yawo kufuma kwa isanga ja kichuku cha Efraimu.
Wikanekwa muzi ghokimbiria ghwa Shekemu, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;
Jokmeamu, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Beth-horoni, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;
Aijaloni, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Gath-rimoni, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;

na kufuma kwa nusu ya kichuku cha Manase werenekeloghe Aneri chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; na Bileamu chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira. Ihi ni kwa wundu ghwa nyumba risigharikie ra Wakohathi.
Wagershomu werenekeloghe kufuma kwa kichuku cha nusu ya Manase iko cha mashariki: Golani ghuko Bashani, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; na Ashtarothi, chiamweri na milamba yaro elishira.
Kufuma kwa kichuku cha Isakari werenekeloghe; Kadeshi, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Daberathi, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;
Ramothi, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; na Anemu chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira.
Kufuma kwa kichuku cha Asheri, werenekeloghe: Mashali, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Abdoni, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;
Hukoku, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; na Rehobu, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira.

Kufuma kwa kichuku cha Naftali, werenekeloghe: Kedeshi iko Galilaya, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Hamoni, chaimweri na milamba yaro elishira na Kiriathaimu, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira.
Wamerari wisigharikie, werenekeloghe kufuma kwa kichuku cha Zebluni: Rimono chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira. Tabori, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;

na kufuma kwa kichuku cha Reubeni cherekoghe chikikaia cha Jeriko, kimonu cha Jordani luwaru lwa mashariki; werenekeloghe: Bezeri iko nyika, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Jahsa, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;
Kedemothi, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; na Mefaathi chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira.
Kufuma kwa kichuku cha Gadi, werenekeloghe: Ramothi iko Gileadi, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira; Mahanaimu, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira;
Heshboni, chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira. Na Jazeri chiaimweri na milamba yaro elishira.
